facts.statement_en: Systematic review and pairwise meta-analysis of intervention studies.

Adults with sepsis or septic shock; intravenous-fluid resuscitation guided by dynamic measures of fluid responsiveness versus no dynamic guidance; patient-important clinical and resuscitative outcomes.
Eligibility is specified in the accepted protocol; final-review methods are identified separately.
